start.text: Day six. The leak is closed, the key is changed, and the office is back to normal. At lunch, the phone rings again.
start.name: Joshua

B.text: IT desk, this is Joshua. How can I help?
B.name: Joshua

C.text: Joshua? It's Jonas Pike, the web admin. The website is down in the middle of lunch, and everybody says it is Marketing's sale.
C.name: Jonas

E1.text: The sale is a lot of customers, sure. But the sale only starts at 12:00, and I would swear it was slow before that.
E1.name: Jonas

D2.text: Since 11:42, I think. The sale was planned for 12:00. That is eighteen minutes earlier.
D2.name: Jonas

F.text: Then we should not blame the crowd yet. A lot of traffic is not proof of anything. We look at who is asking, and what they do.
F.name: Joshua

G.text: [b][color=green]5 clues[/color][/b] should be enough. Then I compare the graphs and tell the rush from the attack.
G.name: Joshua
